dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 母親が過保護で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with my overprotective mother.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。相談者様の年齢と性別を教えていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 19歳女です
dialogue.English: I'm a 19-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。どういったところが過干渉に感じますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. In what ways do you feel she is overly involved?

dialogue.content: 何でもかんでも口出ししてきます
dialogue.English: She butts into every little thing.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは過干渉だと感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. I can understand why that would feel intrusive.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者様は今は学生さんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently a student?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I am.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。もう少し聞きますね。お住まいは実家ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Let me ask a little more. Do you live at home?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: ご兄弟はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any siblings?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。「何でもかんでも口出ししてきます」とありましたが、もう少し具体的にお伺いしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned that she "butts into every little thing." Could you give me some more specific examples?

dialogue.content: 大学の準備物だったり、服装だったり、帰ってくる時間とか、ことごとく意見してきます。
dialogue.English: My university preparations, my clothes, the time I get home... she has an opinion on everything.

dialogue.content: いろいろなことに意見されるんですね。
dialogue.English: She comments on various things, doesn't she?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのように意見された時、相談者様はどういう感情で、どのような言葉を返されますか？
dialogue.English: When she says those things, how do you feel, and what do you say in response?

dialogue.content: むかつくし、ほっといてよって言います
dialogue.English: I get really annoyed and tell her, "Just leave me alone."

dialogue.content: うんうん。そういう気持ちになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母様の過干渉が嫌だなと感じたのはいつぐらい、前からですか？
dialogue.English: About how long have you been bothered by your mother's over-involvement?

dialogue.content: 高校くらいから、特に感じました
dialogue.English: I especially started to feel it around high school.

dialogue.content: 長い間我慢されていたのですね。
dialogue.English: So you've been putting up with it for a long time.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: その時もお母様に対して同様に「むかつくし、ほっといてよ」という感じでしたか？
dialogue.English: Back then, did you also react to your mother in the same way, feeling irritated and telling her to leave you alone?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I did.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。少し遡って、小学校、中学校の時はどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Going back a bit further, what was it like in elementary and junior high school?

dialogue.content: 母親はずっとそんな感じです。言われるままに動いてました
dialogue.English: My mother has always been like that. I used to just do as I was told.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それが高校生へと年齢を重ねるごとにウザさ？を感じるようになってきたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So as you got older and became a high school student, it started to feel more... annoying?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right...

dialogue.content: 少し難しいですが今、自分自身に対して、どういう感情を抱きますか？
dialogue.English: This might be a difficult question, but how do you feel about yourself right now?

dialogue.content: 自分自身？うーん、考えたことないですね…よくわかりません。
dialogue.English: About myself? Hmm, I've never really thought about it... I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ちなみにお父様はどのような感じですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. By the way, what is your father like?

dialogue.content: なんか我関せずって感じです。関わってきません。
dialogue.English: He's kind of indifferent; he doesn't get involved.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。二人でやってくれという感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it's like he wants the two of you to sort it out yourselves.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、少し助けてくれよ。という気持ちになりますね。
dialogue.English: That would make you wish he’d help out a bit, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね、何考えてるのかわからない感じです。期待してません。
dialogue.English: That's right. I have no idea what he's thinking. I don't expect anything from him.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 一回整理してもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what I've heard so far?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 同居している母親の過干渉に悩んでるずっと、母はそのような感じで、高校生くらいから我慢していた。父はあまり干渉してこない。期待できない。相談者様は過干渉をやめてほしいと考えている。
dialogue.English: You're troubled by the over-involvement of your mother, whom you live with. She has always been this way, and you've been putting up with it since about high school. Your father doesn't get involved much, and you feel you can't expect help from him. You want your mother to stop being so over-involved.

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: そうですね、そのような感じです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's about right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お母さんの過干渉によって、何か行動的に障害が起きていることはありますか？例えば、友達と遊びにいけないとか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are there any ways this over-involvement is hindering your actions? For example, not being able to go out with friends.

dialogue.content: 早く帰ってこいと言われるので、友達と遊んでも途中で抜けないといけないです…服にも口出しされるので、身支度に時間がかかります
dialogue.English: She tells me to come home early, so even if I go out with friends I have to leave partway through. She also comments on my clothes, so it takes a long time to get ready.

dialogue.content: それは、イライラしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very frustrating.

dialogue.content: すごく鬱陶しいです。
dialogue.English: It's extremely annoying.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そういう気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、服装に関してはどのようなことを言われるんですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what kinds of things does she say about your clothing?

dialogue.content: その服は下品だとか、可愛くないとか、言われます
dialogue.English: She says things like, "That outfit is tacky," or "That's not cute."

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。趣味が合わないか、娘にコレを着て欲しいという、感情がお母様にはあるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it seems your tastes don't align, or perhaps your mother has a certain image of what she wants her daughter to wear.

dialogue.content: わかりませんが、そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I'm not sure, but that might be it.

dialogue.content: 押し付けてくるので。
dialogue.English: She's so pushy about it.

dialogue.content: お母様とこの件について、話し合ったことはありますか？やめてくれとか。
dialogue.English: Have you talked to your mother about this—for example, asking her to stop?

dialogue.content: 母にはほっといてよって言いますが、あなたの為を思ってやってるんだ！って言って聞きません。
dialogue.English: I tell her to leave me alone, but she insists, "I'm doing this for your own good!" and won't listen.

dialogue.content: なるほど、話が平行線になってしまいますよね。ただ、やめて欲しいものはやめて欲しいですもんね。
dialogue.English: I see, the conversation just goes in circles. But you still want the things you want her to stop, to stop, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね…いい加減鬱陶しいです。
dialogue.English: That's right... I'm really fed up with it.

dialogue.content: うんうん。では、これからどうしたら良くなるか一緒に考えて行きましょう。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Well then, let's think together about what we can do to make things better.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: お母さんはどうして、いろいろうるさく言ってしまうと思いますか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think your mother is so nagging about so many things?

dialogue.content: 母の言う通りにして欲しいんだと思います。今もずっと
dialogue.English: I think she wants me to do exactly as she says. She still does, even now.

dialogue.content: 昔から変わりません。
dialogue.English: She's always been this way.

dialogue.content: うんうん、性格的だったり、自分の中に納めておきたいのか？と感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it makes you feel like it's either just her personality, or that she wants to keep you under her control, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: 最終的に自立したいですよね。相談者様的には服装や行動いろいろありますが、どれが一番自由にさせて欲しいですか？
dialogue.English: Ultimately, you want to be independent, right? Between all these things, like your clothes and your activities, which one do you most want to have freedom with?

dialogue.content: 全部ですね。どれかひとつではなく、母の束縛から逃れたいです。
dialogue.English: All of them. It's not just one thing; I want to escape from my mother's control.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。全部一気にいけたらいいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It would be great if you could solve everything at once, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、もう限界なんです…
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm at my limit...

dialogue.content: うんうん、辛かったですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that must have been very difficult.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: もうすぐ、成人を迎えるじゃ無いですか？そのことについてお母様とお話したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: You'll be coming of age soon, won't you? Have you ever talked with your mother about that?

dialogue.content: ありません。
dialogue.English: No, I haven't.

dialogue.content: 一つ先に大きな節目があるので、そこのきっかけだったりをうまく利用したいですよね。
dialogue.English: There's a big milestone coming up, so it would be good to use that as an opportunity, don't you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、そうしたいです…
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like to do that...

dialogue.content: 家を出たいです
dialogue.English: I want to move out.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そういう気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it's understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、まずお母様にこの辛い思いを理解して欲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: But first, you want your mother to understand these painful feelings you're having, right?

dialogue.content: 辛いというか…もう好きにさせて欲しいですね…
dialogue.English: It's less about it being painful... and more that I just want her to let me do things my own way.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もう何も出来ない子供ではありませんし…。
dialogue.English: I'm not a helpless child anymore...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。いつまで？って感じちゃいますよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. It makes you wonder, "How long is this going to go on?" doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お母様と直接話すと、また平行線になりそうな気もしなくも無いので、例えば成人に向けてのお手紙や親族以外の第３者から伝えるという方法はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since talking to your mother directly seems to lead to a stalemate, how about another approach? For example, writing her a letter for your coming-of-age, or having a third party who isn't a relative convey your feelings?

dialogue.content: 手紙は書いたこと自体ないので気が引けます。親族は…このことを相談したことがなく、いきなり言うのは勇気がいります。
dialogue.English: I've never written a letter like that, so I'm hesitant. As for my relatives... I've never talked to them about this, so bringing it up out of the blue would take a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。なかなか難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. That does sound difficult, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 家を出たいということはお話したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever told her that you want to move out?

dialogue.content: ずっと考えてはいるのですが、言ったことはありません。
dialogue.English: I've been thinking about it for a long time, but I've never actually said it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。話を聞いていて、やはりお母様は相談者様は一人娘で可愛すぎるのだと思います。でも、もう子供じゃ無いですもんね。
dialogue.English: I see. Listening to you, it sounds like because you're her only daughter, your mother finds you too precious to let go. But you're not a child anymore, are you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。自立したいです
dialogue.English: That's right. I want to be independent.

dialogue.content: うんうん。お母様と今までとシチュエーションを変えたりして、大人になったんだよ。ということをまず理解してもらうところからいきたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It seems like the first step is to help your mother understand that you're an adult now, perhaps by changing the situation when you talk to her.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 応援してます。そろそろお時間がきてしまいました、本日は相談して見ていかがでしたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm here to support you. It looks like our time is almost up. How do you feel after our discussion today?

dialogue.content: 聞いていただいて、少し気分がスッキリしました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I feel a little better just having someone listen. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございます。本日のカウンセリングを終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. We'll conclude the session for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.
